topic: 2025 ownership change and first long-term offtake
wiki_text: On 28-29 January 2025, the US$3.3 billion deal to acquire the Philippines' first integrated LNG complex reached financial close. Through Chromite Gas Holdings, Inc. (CGHI) — owned 60% by Meralco PowerGen (MGEN) and 40% by Aboitiz Power's Therma NatGas Power (TNGP) — together with San Miguel Global Power (SMGP), the consortium acquired 100% of Linseed Field Corporation (LFC), the entity that owns and operates the Batangas (Ilijan) LNG import and regasification terminal, reportedly with CGHI holding 67% and SMGP 33% of the relevant special-purpose vehicles. AG&P LNG (majority-owned since early 2024 by US firm Nebula Energy, which invested US$300 million for its stake) continues as the terminal operator. Separately, in March 2025 trading house Vitol signed the first long-term LNG supply agreement into the Philippines, for about 0.8 mtpa over ten years, with the Philippines LNG Terminal.
